_help: Every notification wording lives here. The bot picks one at random and never repeats a wording it used recently for that app.
Add, edit or delete lines freely. Each line needs a title and a body.
A wording is skipped automatically when one of its placeholders has no value (or is 0).
Optional per line: "hours": [from, to] (Nairobi time, e.g. [5, 12] = mornings), "days": ["sat","sun"], "image": "https://..."
